task_schema.subject: string, short human subject, required
task_schema.owner: string, teammate name or agent name, required
task_schema.owner_type: one of: lead | teammate | subagent | human
task_schema.status: one of: pending | in_progress | blocked | complete | abandoned
task_schema.mandatory: boolean, default true; false marks an optional task
task_schema.required_artifacts: array of repository-relative paths that must exist
task_schema.required_receipts: array of receipt selectors; see receipt_selector_schema
task_schema.required_validation_commands: array of exact commands that must appear in a passing receipt
task_schema.blocking_critical_findings: array of finding ids that must be empty to complete
task_schema.required_review_artifacts: array of repository-relative review report paths
task_schema.worktree: string or null; repository-relative worktree/branch identity
task_schema.completion_evidence: object written by the completion gate on success
task_schema.acceptance_gates: informational: acceptance gates in ACCEPTANCE_STATUS.json this task feeds

receipt_selector_schema.task_id: string, required; must match the receipt task_id
receipt_selector_schema.command: string, optional; exact command that must have been run
receipt_selector_schema.must_pass: boolean, default true; requires receipt exit_code == 0 and valid == true

ownership_rules: One primary writer owns each tightly coupled subsystem; two agents never write the same subsystem concurrently.
implementation-agent is the single primary writer for the current implementation task.
test-watchdog owns monitored test execution and evidence integrity; it must not modify production code during a frozen evaluation.
investigation-agent, adversarial-reviewer, and final-adjudicator are read-only.
Every mandatory phase must also exist in Claude Code's structured task system so TaskCompleted receives completion events.
